Welcome!

Welcome to OldSchool.tools! We're a site built around a 100% focus on Old School RuneScape. We offer Skill Calculators and other Tools and Calculators such as our Combat Level Calculator, Melee Max Hit, and Ranged Max Hit calculators! We've got some other useful utilities such as an Interactive World Map and Experience Table - and more on the way!

Do you wish we had a tool we don't have? Why not send a Suggestion our way! Thanks for visiting OldSchool.tools!
